briefdescription.para: Check if pointer was allocated by this arena.

detaileddescription.para:
Check if pointer was allocated by this arena
ptr
Pointer to check
true if pointer was allocated by this arena, false otherwise
Checks if the given pointer points to memory within any of this arena's chunks. This is useful for debugging and validation.

Returns false for:
nullptr
Pointers allocated by other arenas
Pointers allocated by other allocators
Invalid pointers
